title: Net worth
liabilitiesPending: It doesn't include your own debts yet (cards are included).

accounts.defineLabel: Set the starting balance of {{name}} in Settings
accounts.emptyBody: Create your first account in Settings so its balance counts toward your net worth.

goals.title: Set aside for goals
goals.body: This money is already in your accounts: it's shown here so you know how much is reserved, but it isn't added to your net worth again.

liabilities.title: Liabilities
liabilities.noCards: No card has a limit set. Set them up in Settings so their debt counts here.
liabilities.availableInfo: Available on your cards: {{amount}}. It's credit, not your money: it doesn't add to your net worth.
liabilities.debtsBody: Your own debts (loans you received) aren't tracked in Cashifa yet, so they don't subtract here.

cards.title: Cards not set up
cards.body: Their balance isn't added or subtracted from your net worth because it doesn't say how much you owe yet. Match them to their last statement so their debt counts.
